# integrations.yml in detail

## Optional infrastructure sections

```yaml integrations.yml
# Tracing. One tracer, or a list with at most one langfuse entry and at most one
# otlp or jaeger entry. Langfuse keys use ${VAR} syntax.
tracing:
  - type: langfuse
    public_key: ${LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY}
    private_key: ${LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY}
    host: https://cloud.langfuse.com
  - type: otlp
    endpoint: localhost:4317
    insecure: true

# OTLP metrics, independent of tracing.
metrics:
  type: otlp
  endpoint: localhost:4317
  insecure: true

# Event broker. Omit it to publish no events. type defaults to pika; url,
# username, and password are required for pika (even with an amqp:// URL). url is
# required for kafka and concurrent_kafka; file uses path; sql uses url as the
# database host.
event_broker:
  type: pika
  url: ${RABBITMQ_URL}
  username: ${RABBITMQ_USERNAME}
  password: ${RABBITMQ_PASSWORD}
  queues:
    - rasa_events

# Timer store. Omit it to keep timers in memory. redis uses host and port.
timer_store:
  type: redis
  host: localhost
  port: 6379
  password: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}

# Remote model server: rasa_model_server, not the models list inside a model
# group. wait_time_between_pulls defaults to 100; 0 pulls once.
rasa_model_server:
  url: http://my-server.example/models/default@latest
  token: ${MODEL_SERVER_TOKEN}
  wait_time_between_pulls: 10

# Call recordings. Omit it (or leave enabled false) to keep recording off.
recordings:
  enabled: true
  provider: s3
  s3:
    bucket: rasa-call-recordings
    region: eu-central-1
    prefix: recordings/
```

- `tracing`, `metrics`, `event_broker`, `timer_store`, `tracker_store`, `lock_store`,
  `secrets_manager`, `rasa_model_server`, and `recordings` are optional and read
  **only** from `integrations.yml`. A Mantle project has no `endpoints.yml`: one at
  the project root fails startup, so every section it held belongs here.
- `recordings:` `provider` is `s3` (the default), `gcs`, `azure`, or `local`; when
  `enabled` is `true`, that provider's block is required (`s3` / `gcs`: `bucket`;
  `azure`: `container` and `account_name`; `local`: `path`). `prefix` defaults to
  `recordings/`.
- Configure the inbound A2A server with a top-level `a2a_server` block.
- `lock_store:` defaults to in-memory; use `redis` or `concurrent_redis` with more
  than one worker or replica. `secrets_manager:` is `type: vault`, and `VAULT_*`
  environment variables still override it.
- `rasa_model_server:` (`url` required) is the remote model server. The `models` list
  under a `model_groups` entry is the LLM list; they are different keys. With no
  local model, the agent asks for `rasa_model_server:` at startup.

## Validation codes

- An invalid `tracing:` or `metrics:` section is reported as
  `mantle.validation.config.invalid_tracing` / `invalid_metrics`. If the agent starts
  anyway, it runs without that tracer or without metrics.
- An invalid `event_broker:`, `timer_store:`, `tracker_store:`, `lock_store:`,
  `secrets_manager:`, `rasa_model_server:`, or `recordings:` (`invalid_event_broker`,
  `invalid_timer_store`, `invalid_tracker_store`, `invalid_lock_store`,
  `invalid_secrets_manager`, `invalid_model_server`, `invalid_recordings`) fails
  validation and startup.
- A literal `password`, `token`, or credential URL on `tracker_store:`,
  `lock_store:`, or `secrets_manager:` is a warning (`literal_secret`), not an error.
- CALM-only keys (`nlg`, `nlu`, `action_endpoint`, `vector_store`,
  `interaction_handling`) fail validation, and the finding names the replacement.
  The silence timeout that `interaction_handling` held is `voice.silence_timeout` in
  `agent.yml`.

## Model groups

Required for the agent's LLM, and also used by the optional embedders:

```yaml integrations.yml
model_groups:
  - id: main_model
    models:
      - provider: openai
        model: gpt-5.1
  - id: reference_embeddings
    models:
      - provider: openai
        model: text-embedding-3-large
```

```yaml agent.yml
orchestrator:
  model_group: main_model

knowledge_answering:
  embeddings: reference_embeddings
```

The group named by `orchestrator.model_group` is read from the live project, so
changing the models inside it needs a restart; changing which group the field names
needs a train. Embedding groups are read from the packaged model, so changing the
embedding model needs a train.

## Voice channels

Speech recognition and synthesis are configured **inside the voice channel entry**,
under `asr:` and `tts:`. Each takes a `name:` selecting the engine, plus that
engine's settings:

```yaml integrations.yml
channels:
  browser_audio:
    enabled: true
    server_url: localhost:5005
    asr:
      name: deepgram
      language_map:
        en-US:
          language: en
          model: flux-general-en
      eot_threshold: 0.8
    tts:
      name: deepgram
      language_map:
        en-US:
          model: aura-2-asteria-en
```

Built-in ASR engines: `deepgram`, `azure`. Built-in TTS engines: `deepgram`,
`azure`, `cartesia`, `rime`. The same `asr:` / `tts:` shape applies to every voice
channel, including `jambonz`, `audiocodes`, and `twilio_media_streams`; only the
telephony connection differs.
